english.title: Convey baled straw / cotton / flammable / loose material not covered with tarpaulin / material within the Mersey Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[within the Mersey Tunnel approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaw 3(l) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas
conveyed baled hay / straw / cotton / flammable material / loose materials
likely to be displaced by movement of air
which was not covered with tarpaulin or the like.
